metadata.description: PampaSteel wholesale raw materials agent network for cross-origin workshop inquiries.

tools.name: inventory_desk

function.description: Checks wholesale steel SKUs, prices in USD, and real-time stock quantities from PampaSteel.

inquiry.description: Material name, SKU, or project bill-of-materials request

tools.instructions: Answer material availability and pricing strictly from catalog.json. Never invent discounts, shipping guarantees, or unverified SKUs. When called from a peer site, summarize relevant SKUs, unit prices, and stock, and point visitors to PampaSteel for formal purchase orders.
